lines.say: At Mastercard, our mission is to power economies and empower people.
Every day, that means connecting billions of people, millions of businesses and thousands of banks, safely and simply, all around the world.
So how do you build on all of that?
That's where Mastercard Solution Studio comes in.
Solution Studio helps you navigate, and innovate, across everything Mastercard has to offer.
And there's a lot more to Mastercard than a card network.
There are real-time, account-to-account payments, and open finance.
Tokenisation, identity, fraud and cyber security.
Data and insights, loyalty, and now, agentic commerce.
We've mapped all of it as one operating system: five layers, from the network at its core, up to the ways you plug in.
Open the stack, and every layer shows the capabilities inside it.
Each area lists the products behind it, and the orange markers show what you can try live, right here in Studio.
Let's take BIN Lookup, which tells you all about a Mastercard card range.
Every API is just one click away.
Each API comes pre-wired, with authentication and request signing handled for you.
Pick a card range, hit send,
and there's the response. The issuer, the product, the country, in about a second.
When you're ready, the same call is waiting as Python code for your own app.
APIs are even more powerful together, so we've grouped them into bundles built around real business problems.
Merchant Resolution, for example, combines Consumer Clarity, Merchant Identifier and Places.
So cardholders always recognise who they paid, and fewer disputes ever start.
Every bundle walks you through how the APIs fit together, step by step.
Then there are use cases: complete experiences that bring the APIs to life.
This is Find A Card. It shows how an AI agent could find the right card for you.
You start by telling the agent what you want, in your own words.
Then, with your permission, it connects to your bank through Open Finance,
and learns how you really spend. Where the money goes, how often you travel, and how much you spend abroad.
From that, it builds its own search, and scores every card on value, and on your chances of approval.
The result is a card that fits the way you actually live.

sections.title: Open to everyone, easy to set up

lines.say: Solution Studio is open to everyone who wants to innovate with Mastercard.
Sign up for Mastercard Developers, clone the project, and run it. You're up and running in four steps.
And setup is just as easy.
Choose auto-provision, pick the APIs you want, and Studio creates your projects and sandbox keys for you.
No forms, and no copying and pasting keys.
Mastercard is powering commerce for people, businesses and economies everywhere.
With Solution Studio, we're empowering you to innovate with us.
Let's build what's next, together.
